description: Social research and reply drafting from Cigale's tweet index. Search a topic's best posts over recent months, semantically find X posts from the last 24 hours, pull trend reports, and draft a reply to any tweet in a Cigale agent's or campaign's voice.
limitations: Does not post to X or create live guilds. Reply drafts spend the Cigale agent's plan quota and need a Cigale agent id. Historical tweet search covers about five months; recent semantic search is a 24-hour window. Not a general web browser.
setup_hint: Connect with a Cigale public API token. Agent and campaign ids come from the operator's Cigale project.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the tweet knowledge base for the best posts about up to 5 topics over the last five months. Use for deep social research on a token, person, or theme.

tools.name: get_recent_documents
tools.description: Semantic search over tweets posted in an explicit window of at most 24 hours. Pass topic queries plus a from timestamp.

to.description: Window end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

tools.name: generate_reply_options
tools.description: Draft reply options to a tweet in a Cigale agent's voice, optionally for one of its campaigns. Pass tweet id plus agent id. Spends one reply generation; nothing is posted.

tweetId.description: Tweet to reply to: opportunity id (tweet_<id>) or the bare tweet id.

agentId.description: Cigale agent id (UUID). Replies are written in this agent's voice.

campaignId.description: Optional Cigale campaign id (UUID). Layers that campaign's positioning over the agent's voice.

prompt.description: Instruction to the reply strategist. Defaults to Reply.

tools.name: get_top_reply_opportunities
tools.description: Tweets currently worth replying to across tracked feeds, ranked by opportunity score. Optional agent id scopes the feed to what that agent sees.

tools.name: get_campaign_top_reply_opportunities
tools.description: Tweets worth replying to for one of an agent's campaigns. Pass agent id; campaign id defaults to that agent's default campaign.

tools.name: get_reports_list
tools.description: List recent trend reports, optionally filtered by category or sub-category.

tools.name: get_reports_by_string
tools.description: Search trend reports by free-text query, ranked by relevance.

query.description: Free-text query describing the report topic.

tools.name: get_full_report_by_label
tools.description: Full trend report by label: headline, tldr, talking points, and supporting tweet ids.

label.description: Trend report label from the list or search tools.

tools.name: get_report_categories_list
tools.description: List the report category taxonomy (top-level categories and sub-categories).

tools.name: get_predicted_views
tools.description: Look up stored view forecasts for tweets: predicted lifetime views, author-baseline divergence, and momentum.

tweetIds.description: Tweet ids: snowflake, tweet_…, or status URL. Max 100.
